# NexRoute 0.6.2 — Hot Bug Fix

Emergency repair for the first-run diagnostic screen and manual stable updater in the 0.6.1 Windows package.

## Fixed

- the first-run console no longer reads diagnostic properties that do not exist in the schemaVersion 3 report;
- diagnostic compatibility fields `administrator`, `runtime.zapret`, `network`, and `conflicts[].detected` are produced deterministically for the legacy first-run renderer;
- `service.bat` and `nexroute.bat` no longer terminate with `PropertyNotFoundException` before opening the main menu;
- the Windows console title is read from `.service/version.txt` instead of the stale `NexRoute 0.5.0` constant;
- manual update checks now use `nexroute-updater-entry.ps1` and never silently fall back to the unauthenticated GitHub Releases API;
- stable release discovery uses the public `/releases/latest` endpoint with `Invoke-WebRequest`, `HttpWebRequest`, and `curl.exe` fallbacks;
- TLS 1.2 is enabled for Windows PowerShell 5.1 release discovery;
- when public release discovery is unavailable, the updater returns a concise fail-closed error instead of exposing raw GitHub API rate-limit JSON.

## Regression evidence

The online and fully offline package gates copy the extracted release into a directory containing spaces and Cyrillic characters. They then verify:

- API-free stable release discovery through a deterministic `v0.6.2` fixture;
- updater `Status` and `Check` JSON contracts;
- schemaVersion 3 diagnostic compatibility required by the first-run renderer;
- `service.bat --status`;
- `nexroute.bat --status`;
- `nexroute-update.cmd --status`;
- absence of `PropertyNotFoundException`, GitHub API rate-limit output, path exceptions, duplicate parameter binding, and non-zero launcher exits.

## Security boundary

The public release resolver only determines the stable semantic version and constructs official asset URLs under:

```text
https://github.com/Onmaynec/NexRoute/releases/download/v<version>/
```

The existing secure updater core still enforces exact asset names, SHA-256 verification, package structure, version consistency, backup, state preservation, post-update health checks, and rollback.

## Release assets

Keep all four assets together:

- `NexRoute-0.6.2-win-x64.zip`;
- `NexRoute-0.6.2-win-x64.zip.sha256`;
- `NexRoute-0.6.2-validation.json`;
- `NexRoute-0.6.2-validation.md`.

They are generated by one release workflow and covered by one GitHub artifact attestation.

## Compatibility

This hotfix contains the complete NexRoute 0.6.0 feature set and the 0.6.1 Windows launcher fixes. Existing user lists, profiles, history, updater state, and backups remain compatible.
